build_nose_hoover_nvt_thermostat: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat with temperature and damping parameters for NVT molecular dynamics simulation
build_bussi_thermostat: build a Bussi stochastic velocity rescaling thermostat with temperature and relaxation time parameters
build_langevin_thermostat: build a Langevin thermostat with temperature and friction parameters for stochastic dynamics simulation
save_thermostat_state: save the current state of a molecular dynamics thermostat for checkpointing and later restoration
restore_thermostat_state: restore a molecular dynamics thermostat state from a previously saved checkpoint dictionary
